verdict.headline: Overfit warning: the refinement looked good in training but collapsed on the locked final year.
notes: Refined Sharpe fell from 0.80 (train) to -1.25 (locked year): the tuned parameters did not hold up.
On the locked year the refined version returned -13.6% vs -18.7% for your original (small samples can flatter either version).
Best of 400 candidates tried on training data; picking the best of many looks better than it is (multiple testing).
